bind_US_standard.name: Key Binding
bind_US_standard.description: A base key binding in the standard keyboard/controller profile. The first string is the key, the second is the action, and the trailing number is an additional binding state.
bind_US_standard.recommended: Configure it through the in-game key layout

bind_held_US_standard.name: Held Key Binding
bind_held_US_standard.description: The action performed while a key is held in the standard profile, commonly used for controller buttons or actions that distinguish a tap from a hold.
bind_held_US_standard.recommended: Keep the game default unless you have tested the hold behavior

cc_linger_time.name: Caption Linger Time
cc_linger_time.description: How long captions or subtitle prompts remain visible, in seconds.

cc_predisplay_time.name: Caption Predisplay Time
cc_predisplay_time.description: How long captions appear before the related voice line, in seconds.

chroma_enable.name: Chroma Feature
chroma_enable.description: Enables the game's Chroma or supported peripheral-lighting feature when the current build uses it.
chroma_enable.recommended: Keep 0 unless you use the feature

func_break_max_pieces.name: Max Breakable Pieces
func_break_max_pieces.description: Limits the number of fragments created by breakable objects. Lower values reduce physics and rendering cost but simplify destruction effects.
func_break_max_pieces.recommended: Keep the default; lower it only on weak hardware

gfx_amdUseLowLatency.name: AMD Low Latency
gfx_amdUseLowLatency.description: Enables the AMD low-latency path to reduce render-queue input delay. It only applies to supported AMD drivers and game builds.
gfx_amdUseLowLatency.recommended: Use 1 on AMD hardware; keep the default elsewhere

gfx_nvnUseLowLatency.name: NVIDIA Low Latency
gfx_nvnUseLowLatency.description: Enables the NVIDIA low-latency path to reduce render-queue input delay. It only applies to supported NVIDIA drivers and game builds.

gfx_nvnUseLowLatencyBoost.name: NVIDIA Low Latency Boost
gfx_nvnUseLowLatencyBoost.description: An enhancement for NVIDIA low-latency mode that may schedule the GPU more aggressively. It can increase power use or frame-time variance.
gfx_nvnUseLowLatencyBoost.recommended: Keep 1; use 0 if frame pacing worsens

hdr_screenshot_directory.name: HDR Screenshot Directory
hdr_screenshot_directory.description: Directory used for HDR screenshots. An empty value uses the game's or system default screenshot location.

lookspring.name: View Centering
lookspring.description: Controls whether the view automatically returns toward center after movement or certain actions.

lookstrafe.name: Look Strafe
lookstrafe.description: Controls whether lateral movement input also affects view turning, mainly relevant to controller or alternate control schemes.

m_acceleration.name: Mouse Acceleration
m_acceleration.description: Applies acceleration to mouse movement when enabled. Turning it off makes mouse distance and view movement more linear and consistent.

m_clamp_to_window.name: Clamp Mouse To Window
m_clamp_to_window.description: Keeps the pointer inside the game window while running windowed.

miles_channels.name: Audio Channel Count
miles_channels.description: The output-channel configuration used by the Miles audio system. It changes audio mixing and is not a volume slider.

miles_dumpuploadtime.name: Audio Upload Debug Time
miles_dumpuploadtime.description: A Miles audio debugging parameter for recording upload timing. Most players do not need to change it.

miles_output_device.name: Audio Output Device
miles_output_device.description: Names the output device used by the Miles audio system. Empty uses the system or game default device.
miles_output_device.recommended: Leave empty for the system default

mouse_sensitivity.name: Mouse Sensitivity
mouse_sensitivity.description: In-game mouse sensitivity multiplier for unzoomed view, combined with mouse DPI to determine turn speed.
mouse_sensitivity.recommended: Set it to your preferred feel

mouse_use_per_scope_sensitivity_scalars.name: Per-Scope Sensitivity
mouse_use_per_scope_sensitivity_scalars.description: Uses separate sensitivity scalars for aiming magnification levels when enabled. Each scope level can then be tuned independently.

mouse_zoomed_sensitivity_scalar_0.name: Unzoomed Aim Sensitivity
mouse_zoomed_sensitivity_scalar_0.description: Mouse sensitivity scalar for the unzoomed or first aiming level.
mouse_zoomed_sensitivity_scalar_0.recommended: Set it to your preferred feel

mouse_zoomed_sensitivity_scalar_1.name: Low-Zoom Sensitivity
mouse_zoomed_sensitivity_scalar_1.description: Mouse sensitivity scalar for the second aiming magnification level.
mouse_zoomed_sensitivity_scalar_1.recommended: Set it to your preferred feel

mouse_zoomed_sensitivity_scalar_2.name: Mid-Low Zoom Sensitivity
mouse_zoomed_sensitivity_scalar_2.description: Mouse sensitivity scalar for the third aiming magnification level.
mouse_zoomed_sensitivity_scalar_2.recommended: Set it to your preferred feel

mouse_zoomed_sensitivity_scalar_3.name: Mid-Zoom Sensitivity
mouse_zoomed_sensitivity_scalar_3.description: Mouse sensitivity scalar for the fourth aiming magnification level.
mouse_zoomed_sensitivity_scalar_3.recommended: Set it to your preferred feel

mouse_zoomed_sensitivity_scalar_4.name: High-Zoom Sensitivity
mouse_zoomed_sensitivity_scalar_4.description: Mouse sensitivity scalar for the fifth aiming magnification level.
mouse_zoomed_sensitivity_scalar_4.recommended: Set it to your preferred feel

mouse_zoomed_sensitivity_scalar_5.name: Very High-Zoom Sensitivity
mouse_zoomed_sensitivity_scalar_5.description: Mouse sensitivity scalar for the sixth aiming magnification level.
mouse_zoomed_sensitivity_scalar_5.recommended: Set it to your preferred feel

mouse_zoomed_sensitivity_scalar_6.name: Special Aim Sensitivity 6
mouse_zoomed_sensitivity_scalar_6.description: Mouse sensitivity scalar for the seventh aiming magnification level. The exact scope mapping depends on the game build.
mouse_zoomed_sensitivity_scalar_6.recommended: Set it to your preferred feel

mouse_zoomed_sensitivity_scalar_7.name: Special Aim Sensitivity 7
mouse_zoomed_sensitivity_scalar_7.description: Mouse sensitivity scalar for the eighth aiming magnification level. The exact scope mapping depends on the game build.
mouse_zoomed_sensitivity_scalar_7.recommended: Set it to your preferred feel

sound_num_speakers.name: Speaker Layout
sound_num_speakers.description: The speaker or headset channel layout used for audio output. A wrong value can make positional audio incorrect.
sound_num_speakers.recommended: Match the actual device; stereo is commonly 2

sound_volume_voice.name: Voice Volume
sound_volume_voice.description: Playback volume for squad voice chat. It does not control effects or music volume.

sv_specaccelerate.name: Spectator Acceleration
sv_specaccelerate.description: Movement acceleration for spectator or free-camera mode. Normal matches generally do not use it.

sv_specnoclip.name: Spectator Noclip
sv_specnoclip.description: Allows the spectator free camera to pass through world geometry when supported. It is mainly relevant to spectator or debug states.

sv_specspeed.name: Spectator Move Speed
sv_specspeed.description: Base movement speed for the spectator free camera.

sv_voiceenable.name: Voice Chat Master Switch
sv_voiceenable.description: Enables or disables the game's voice-chat system. Turning it off prevents normal voice communication.

ui_layout_mode.name: UI Layout Mode
ui_layout_mode.description: An internal identifier for the game's user-interface layout mode. Its meaning can vary by build; change it through in-game settings when possible.
ui_layout_mode.recommended: Keep the value generated by the game

voice_input_device.name: Voice Input Device
voice_input_device.description: Names the microphone used for voice chat. Empty uses the system default input device.
voice_input_device.recommended: Leave empty or use the device selected in-game

voice_modenable.name: Voice Chat Module
voice_modenable.description: Enables the voice-chat module. Turning it off affects both voice input and voice playback.

voice_scale.name: Voice Volume Scale
voice_scale.description: A multiplier for voice-chat playback volume.

voice_vox.name: Voice Activation Mode
voice_vox.description: Enables voice activation triggered by a voice threshold when supported.

VoiceChatMode.name: Voice Chat Mode
VoiceChatMode.description: An internal identifier for the voice-chat mode, such as push-to-talk or open microphone. The exact values depend on the game build.
VoiceChatMode.recommended: Change it through in-game voice settings
